name: Sekino Himari
source:
Suzuka’s classmate and best friend.
She has a college-student boyfriend and is sexually experienced, but she has grown bored with the run-of-the-mill sex she has with him.
After forcing Suzuka to confess that she had hooked up with her younger brother, she insists, "Let me do it with your brother too!" and forcibly joins in on the action.
Seeing Kota moaning with teary, watery eyes gives her a thrill, leading her to realize she has a thing for younger boys.

In contrast to Suzuka, she has short hair and an energetic personality. She has a slender build but possesses a large bust.
